blocking_findings.detail: p3a_v33_load.py directly reads P3_PREFLIGHT_CANDIDATE_INVENTORY_v7.csv and allocates the 141 candidates from it. No topology recomputation from populated resolved projections occurs.
The builder reads V32_DIRECT_INTERNAL_AUTHORITY_MISCLASSIFICATION.csv and V32_ATTACHMENT_BRIDGE_OMISSIONS.csv to decide which projections and bridges exist. The tests have become production inputs.
No collision-scope, internal-pair-collision, unresolved-boundary, or hierarchy-relation rows are built. DIRECT_COLLISION packet rows carry empty collision_ids and hard_collisions.
Redirect authority is mapped to DIRECT_COLLISION; coordinate/bounded authority is mapped to HIERARCHICAL_ONLY without a typed redirect, coordinate, or hierarchy object.
Attachment candidates 120-123 contain proposition-only seed components but link only the strict component. Ten seed-internal connectivity edges are incorrectly persisted as attachment projections.

The builder creates one INCOMPLETE_SIGNATURE closure obligation per candidate, anchors it to the first incomplete member and an arbitrary second member, then breaks. It does not represent all affected subjects.
The 40 packets are selected through five broad SQL passes and labeled with four improvised buckets. The eleven target strata and their eligibility rules are not implemented.
No delivered code references or generates P3A_V33_PILOT_CANDIDATE_INDEX.csv, P3A_V33_PILOT_STRATA_RETURN.json, P3A_V33_OBJECT_COUNTS.json, or P3A_V33_TOPOLOGY_RECOMPUTATION.json.
Incomplete-promotion mapping still fails first at missing variant assignment. The stale-hash fixture changes only three top-level hash fields and does not mutate semantic evidence.

verify_handoff_v33.py requires exactly 10 direct rows and 41 bridge rows and trusts pilot/object/query summary JSONs; it does not independently reconstruct topology, constraints, pilot eligibility, or fixtures.
The candidate loader return labels all 487 obligations as unruled_internal_pairs, while populated diagnostics report 336 actual UNRULED pair rows.
